mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions with GDP growth above 3.0% annualized, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as valuations become stretched, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a declining unemployment rate signals a tight labor market forcing aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 declines as manufacturing weakness signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
